entries.mechanism: Maryland FIA Information Memo 26-13 (released 2026-03-04, effective 2026-01-01, supersedes IM 25-12) sets the Allowable TCA Monthly Payment for household size 1 at $348; the primary PDF was fetched and its FIP schedule table verified directly. Axiom encodes the IM 26-13 schedule ($348). PolicyEngine's gov/states/md/tca/maximum_benefit/main.yaml ends at the IM 25-12 schedule effective 2025-01-01 ($339 for size 1), so the 2026 comparison returns the superseded 2025 value. The gap is exactly the IM 26-13 increase for this household size. No PolicyEngine issue tracks the 2026 update yet.
